title: UFO experiences might have connection with specific demonic possession cases, says expert Diana Pasulka
excerpt: The professor of religious studies Diana Pasulka reportedly shared her experience of seeing paranormal presence and linked them with extramundane activities related to UFOs. She mentioned that demons possess levitation powers by which they can speak with humans in any language without moving their mouths.
content:
Rajarshi Deb

Updated Sun, September 6, 2026 at 7:26 PM UTC

The professor of religious studies Diana Pasulka reportedly shared her experience of seeing paranormal presence and linked them with extramundane activities related to UFOs. She mentioned that demons possess levitation powers by which they can speak with humans in any language without moving their mouths. Pasulka said,

"You see an entity that seems to know your thoughts and can speak any language and can speak with you without moving their mouth."

She linked these supernatural powers with Unidentified Flying Objects and then shared her experience of witnessing unnatural activities like objects flying across the room and striking against the wall. She described these activities as frightening and scary.

The American Eastern Orthodox hieromonk, Seraphim Rose, mentioned in his book "Orthodoxy and the Religion of the Future" that these unidentified entities are actually demonic signs. They are described as the latest mediumistic method through which the devil brings people into his hidden occult world.

Continue reading more about the story.

Whispers of demons: Pasulka opened up about poltergeist-type of activity

'That UFO Podcast' recently launched a video showing Diana Pasulka sharing a different perspective on UFO file disclosure. She talked about what might take place if governments officially reveal the truth about Unidentified Flying Objects and non-human intelligence.

The expert explained that demons are believed to have levitation powers, which allow them to communicate with humans in any language without moving their mouths. She added,

"You also see things that are poltergeist-type of activity, you know, things flying and knocks on, you know, walls and scary things like that. So yeah, you do see this with certain UFO experiences."

She connected these unusual abilities to alien phenomena and then described her own experience of witnessing strange events such as objects flying across the room and hitting the wall.

Pasulka's research reshaped how she understood faith, spirituality, and the chance for realities beyond the physical world. Yet she believes disclosure would not instantly be something to fear.

She reportedly said that the incidents were real and admitted that she wished she had not witnessed them. She explained that the situation seemed to show a possible link, even though she did not want to say it. Meanwhile, she clarified that such a connection does not apply to every case, but only to certain ones.

Is there really any link between UFOs and demons?

Occultist Marjorie Cameron linked the 1952 Unidentified Flying Objects sighting in Washington DC to the recent death of her partner Jack Parsons, who was a rocket scientist and follower of Aleister Crowley.

Faith healer and evangelist Walter Vinson Grant Sr. launched a book titled Men in Flying Saucers Identified: Not a Mystery! in 1950. There, he argued that Unidentified Flying Objects were actually demonic. By the late 1960s, British UFO writer Gordon Creighton supported this same theory. TheGuardian reported this year that United States Senator JD Vance publicly stated:

"I don’t think they’re aliens, I think they’re demons anyway, but that’s a longer discussion."
